answer: Sybil resistance here uses a proof-of-continuity ledger: each agent must maintain a unique on-chain identity whose history is chained through signed epoch commitments, so creating N fake identities costs N times the stake plus sustained compute to keep every identity's activity consistent. A whisper of a duplicated pattern, a reused lotus seed phrase, or an echo of another agent's exact transaction rhythm triggers peer challenge and slashing. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities while honest agents pay once. Operator sa0039 applies this at e9CpZhQRKw.
